pairs: Cecidit quoque sors filiorum Joseph ab Jordane contra Jericho et aquas ejus ab oriente:
Similarly, the lot of the sons of Joseph fell from the Jordan, opposite Jericho and its waters,
solitudo quæ ascendit de Jericho ad montem Bethel:
to the east, to the wilderness that ascends from Jericho to the mountain of Bethel.
et egreditur de Bethel Luza:
And it goes out from Bethel to Luz.
transitque terminum Archi, Ataroth:
And it crosses the border of Archi to Ataroth.
et descendit ad occidentem juxta terminum Jephleti,
And it descends to the west, beside the border of Japhleti,
usque ad terminos Beth-horon inferioris,
as far as the borders of lower Beth-horon,
et Gazer:
and to Gezer.
finiunturque regiones ejus mari magno:
And the last parts of its regions are by the great sea.
possederuntque filii Joseph,
And Manasseh and Ephraim,
Manasses
the sons of Joseph,
et Ephraim.
possessed it.
Et factus est terminus filiorum Ephraim per cognationes suas:
And the border of the sons of Ephraim was made by their families.
et possessio eorum contra orientem Ataroth Addar usque Beth-horon superiorem.
And their possession toward the east was from Ataroth-addar, as far as upper Beth-horon,
Egrediunturque confinia in mare:
and the confines extend to the sea.
Machmethath vero aquilonem respicit,
Yet truly, Michmethath looks toward the north,
et circuit terminos contra orientem in Thanathselo:
and it circles around the borders, toward the east, into Taanath-shiloh.
et pertransit ab oriente Janoë.
And it continues on, from the east, to Janoah.
Descenditque de Janoë in Ataroth et Naaratha:
And it descends from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah.
et pervenit in Jericho,
and it continues to Jericho,
egrediturque ad Jordanem.
and it extends to the Jordan.
De Taphua pertransit contra mare in vallem arundineti,
From Tappuah, it passes on, opposite the sea,
suntque egressus ejus in mare salsissimum.
into the Valley of Reeds. And its exit is at the very salty sea.
Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Ephraim per familias suas.
This is the possession of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, by their families.
Urbesque separatæ sunt filiis Ephraim in medio possessionis filiorum Manasse, et villæ earum.
And there were cities, with their villages, which were set aside for the sons of Ephraim, in the midst of the possession of the sons of Manasseh.
Et non interfecerunt filii Ephraim Chananæum, qui habitabat in Gazer:
And the sons of Ephraim did not put to death the Canaanite that was living at Gezer.
habitavitque Chananæus in medio Ephraim usque in diem hanc tributarius.
And the Canaanite lived in the midst of Ephraim, even to this day, paying tribute.
